scientific_claim: Under the frozen real-byte resource-pressure test, Yggdrasil reduced sixteen learned raw-byte motif structures to exactly eight active structures while hibernating the other eight into 48 logical bytes. On both held-out files the pressured state preserved at least 56.6% of the full model's incremental correct predictions, retained +0.306 covered-position top-1 gain over the previous-byte baseline, and reduced effective event count by 2.52%, with exact hibernated-record integrity and zero capacity growth.
next_question: Can raw-byte cue evidence selectively wake only the hibernated motifs needed by a held-out file, under the same eight-active ceiling, while evicting unneeded active motifs and restoring more of the full-model benefit without retraining?
scope: immutable repo-owned real UTF-8 project prose; eight-active resource pressure with bounded retained motif state
